# Next.js App Router — Library Stack

> **Versioning policy**: this document does not pin versions. When introducing or upgrading a library, install the **latest stable** at that time. Lock files (`package-lock.json` / `pnpm-lock.yaml`) record the actual version used in the project.

---

## Core framework

| Library | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `next` | Next.js (App Router) |
| `react`, `react-dom` | React |
| `typescript` | Type system |
| `tailwindcss` | Utility-first CSS (alongside Mantine for spacing / layout fine-tuning) |

---

## UI

| Library | Purpose | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `@mantine/core` | Main UI component library — Buttons, Inputs, Tabs, Modal, Table, etc. | Primary UI source — prefer Mantine over hand-rolled components |
| `@mantine/dates` | Date input components | `DateInput`, `DatePicker` |
| `@mantine/hooks` | Mantine-provided React hooks | `useDisclosure`, `useMediaQuery`, `useDebouncedValue` |
| `@mantine/modals` | Modal management (imperative API + provider) | Wrap app in `ModalsProvider` |
| `@tabler/icons-react` | Icon set (primary) | Pair with Mantine |
| `react-icons` | Icon set (secondary, fallback for icons not in tabler) | Use only when tabler doesn't have it |
| `mantine-datatable` | Sortable/paginated table component | For complex list views |
| `framer-motion` | Animation library | Use sparingly for meaningful motion only |

### Mantine — required setup

```tsx
// app/(core)/_components/providers.tsx
import { MantineProvider, createTheme } from "@mantine/core"
import { ModalsProvider } from "@mantine/modals"

const theme = createTheme({
  fontSizes: { xs: "12px", sm: "13px", md: "14px", lg: "16px", xl: "18px" },
  defaultRadius: "sm",
})

<MantineProvider theme={theme}>
  <ModalsProvider>
    {children}
  </ModalsProvider>
</MantineProvider>
```

### Most-used Mantine components

```
Box, Text, Button, Group, Stack, Card, Paper, Title, Modal,
Tabs, Avatar, Badge, Divider, ThemeIcon, Center, LoadingOverlay,
ActionIcon, Input, TextInput, NumberInput, Select, Table, Menu,
Alert, Accordion, Radio, Textarea, PillsInput, Combobox, Rating,
Indicator, Drawer, ScrollArea, NavLink, Switch, UnstyledButton,
RingProgress, Progress, PasswordInput, Anchor, Checkbox, DateInput
```

## Form & validation

| Library | Purpose | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `react-hook-form` | Form state management | Single source of truth for form values + errors |
| `@hookform/resolvers` | Bridge between react-hook-form and Zod | `zodResolver(schema)` |
| `zod` | Schema validation + type inference | Define schema in `form.ts`, infer type with `z.infer<>` |

### Standard combo

```ts
import { useForm } from "react-hook-form"
import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod"
import { ResourceFormSchema, ResourceFormType } from "../form"

const { register, handleSubmit, formState: { errors }, setValue, watch, reset } =
  useForm<ResourceFormType>({
    resolver: zodResolver(ResourceFormSchema),
    defaultValues: { /* ... */ },
  })
```

See `frontend/patterns/form.md` for the full pattern.

## Data fetching / server state

| Library | Purpose | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `@tanstack/react-query` | Server state (caching, loading, errors, mutations) | Use `useQuery` (read) / `useMutation` (write) |

### QueryClient setup

```ts
// app/(core)/tanstack.ts
import { QueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query"

export const queryClient = new QueryClient({
  defaultOptions: {
    queries: {
      staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,     // 5 minutes fresh
      gcTime: 10 * 60 * 1000,        // 10 minutes garbage collection
      refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
      refetchOnMount: false,
      refetchOnReconnect: false,
    },
  },
})
```

> Form-loading hooks override `staleTime: 0, refetchOnMount: "always"` to ensure the form always shows the latest server state.

## Global state

| Library | Purpose | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `zustand` | Lightweight global state store | For cross-screen UI state (theme, modals, transient state) |

Use Zustand **only** when:
- State spans multiple unrelated routes
- Cannot be modeled as server state (TanStack Query) or local state (`useState`)
- Cannot be solved with React Context

If a Context provider would suffice, prefer Context (see `state-management.md`).

## Database

| Library | Purpose | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `drizzle-orm` | Type-safe ORM (SQL builder + relational queries) | Schema in `drizzle/schema.ts` |
| `drizzle-zod` | Generate Zod schemas from Drizzle table definitions | Optional |
| `postgres` | PostgreSQL client (used by Drizzle) | Connection layer |

See `backend/database.md`.

---

## Auth

| Library | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `@supabase/supabase-js` | Supabase client (used in browser and server) |
| `@supabase/auth-helpers-nextjs` | Next.js helpers for Supabase Auth |
| `@supabase/ssr` | SSR-friendly auth helpers (cookies, server components) |

Authentication: Supabase Auth → wrapped in `getAuthContext()` for API routes (returns `{ db, userId }`).

> Replace with another auth provider when needed; the same `getAuthContext()` interface should be preserved.

## Notifications & feedback

| Library | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `react-hot-toast` | Toast notifications (success/error after mutations) |

### Usage

```ts
import toast from "react-hot-toast"

toast.success("Saved", { duration: 1500 })
toast.error("Failed to save")
```

---

## Error handling

| Library | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `react-error-boundary` | Component-level error boundary (used at the providers level) |

```tsx
import { ErrorBoundary } from "react-error-boundary"
import { ErrorFallback } from "@/app/(core)/error/ErrorFallback"

<ErrorBoundary fallbackRender={(props) => <ErrorFallback {...props} />}>
  {children}
</ErrorBoundary>
```

## Logging

| Library | Purpose |
|---|---|
| (none) | Use the custom logger in `app/(core)/logger.ts` — see `shared/logger.md` |

The logger emits JSON Lines; no third-party logger library is required.

## When to use what — quick decision table

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| UI component (button, input, modal, …) | Mantine — check existing components first |
| Icon | `@tabler/icons-react` (fallback: `react-icons`) |
| Form state | `react-hook-form` + `zodResolver` |
| Form validation schema | Zod (in `form.ts`) |
| Server data fetch | `useQuery` (TanStack Query) |
| Server data mutation | `useMutation` (TanStack Query) |
| Toast notification | `react-hot-toast` |
| Cross-route UI state | Context first; Zustand if Context insufficient |
| Local UI state | `useState` |
| Conditional className | `clsx` |
| DB query | Drizzle (in `db.ts`) |
| Authentication context | Supabase (via `getAuthContext()`) |
| Date input | `@mantine/dates` |
| Complex table (sort/page) | `mantine-datatable` |
| Logging | Custom logger (see `shared/logger.md`) |

---

## Constraints — what NOT to add

- **Do not add another UI library** (Material UI, Chakra, Ant Design) — Mantine is the single source of truth
- **Do not add another form library** (Formik, react-final-form) — stick with `react-hook-form`
- **Do not add another fetch library** for server state (SWR, Apollo) — `@tanstack/react-query` is canonical
- **Do not add Redux / Recoil / Jotai** — use TanStack Query (server data), Context (cross-cutting UI), or Zustand (rare cases)
- **Do not add `axios`** — native `fetch` is sufficient; client-side helpers live in `app/api/{resource}/client.ts`
- **Do not add `moment` / `date-fns` as default** — start with native `Date` and `Intl`; only add `date-fns` if many date manipulations are needed

When introducing a new library, document the rationale here and update the decision table above.
